verdict.rationale: Drata does its own personnel compliance tracking: it says it monitors personnel, its API exposes Personnel list/search/get endpoints, and a community commenter notes that anyone in the corporate directory shows up as noncompliant in the Drata dashboard until they comply. That is directory-driven per-person compliance status, but the evidence never describes onboarding or offboarding workflows specifically. Missing for 10: HR system (HRIS) sync, onboarding/offboarding checklists, security-training completion tracking, evidence that leavers' access was revoked, and any independent or hands-on corroboration of these workflows.
